messages.subject: Error part 2
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have been working with my script for some time now, and analysis using a csv file to obtain seperated MVPA data during day-segments has been fine up to a couple of days ago.

Now, I keep encountering the Error
Error in `[.data.frame`(df, which(df$ID == ji & df$calendar_date == hi), : undefined columns selected

I have checked for all the available updates after this error kept coming up, as well as redefined my csv file, but the error keeps popping up.
If I reanalyse the same data file, I receive my outputs for all parts (which it never does running it the first time), but they are only containing the information of the entire day, ignoring my request to have it segmented.

Has anyone encountered this error before. Might there be a new one? Because up to last week I did receive outputs containing all the desired information. Is there something else I might be able to do? 

Kind regards 
Jessie

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Error part 2
parts:
Hi Jessie,

I would need more information to investigate this.

1- What GGIR version are you using?
2- How are you defining the day segments? Are you using an activity log or are you setting fixed time segments for all participants?
3- If you are using an activity log, did you make sure the IDs and date formats are correct?

Best,
Jairo
